title: N67: GARCH ceiling confirmed for ALL 5 assets — Ljung-Box p>0.30 everywhere
description: Tested GARCH forecasting ceiling across SPY, QQQ, GLD, TLT, EEM. All 5 assets show clean residuals: Ljung-Box z^2 p>0.30 at all lags (5/10/20). GARCH(1,1)/GJR(1,1) reaches the information ceiling for daily returns universally, not just for SPY. QLIKE ceiling varies by asset: SPY -8.667, GLD -8.430, EEM -8.248, TLT -8.144, QQQ -7.966. This strengthens the paper's Contribution 4 by showing it's not SPY-specific. The only path beyond the ceiling is intraday data, regardless of asset.
